propositions: Extraction of shared units from adapters/jira/ requires pinning the current output of every moved unit via exact-value assertions in the characterization test suite to detect silent mapping regressions during the move
The existing contract suite is backend-agnostic and cannot detect Jira-specific mapping regressions, so new golden-value characterization tests are required alongside it

Status and priority value maps, field sanitizers, identity conventions, probe response classifications, and link relations must each have comprehensive exact-value assertions covering all documented keys, defaults, edge cases, and error conditions
Unit tests must verify that altering source values in pinned units causes the characterization suite to fail, proving the oracle actually gates changes
Two independent copies of local-to-Jira value maps have already drifted, indicating a pre-existing defect separate from this ticket
